translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content: Ka jadolo Pashur wuod Imer, jatelo maduongʼ manie hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye, nowinjo Jeremia kakoro gigie,
nomiyo Jeremia janabi ogo mi otweye e lodi mar Dhorangach Mamalo mar Benjamin mantiere e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye.
Kinyne, ka Pashur nogonye e lodi, Jeremia nowachone niya, “Jehova Nyasaye ok luongi ni Pashur, to oluongi ni Magor-Misabib.

Nimar ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: ‘Anami ibed masira ni in iwuon kaachiel gi osiepeni duto; gi wengeni iwuon ininegi ka inegogi gi ligangla mar wasikgi. Anachiw jo-Juda duto ni ruodh Babulon, manotergi e piny Babulon kata negogi gi ligangla.
Anami wasikgi mwandu duto mar dala maduongʼni gige duto moloso, gige duto ma nengogi tek kod mwandu duto mokan mag ruodhi Juda. Ginikawgi kaka gima opee mi notingʼ-gi ka iterogi Babulon.
To in, Pashur, kod jogo duto modak e odi noteru e twech Babulon. Kanyo unuthoe kendo noyiku, in kod osiepeni duto mane isekoronegi miriambo.’ ”

content.text: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, ne iwuonda kendo nowuonda;
aywak ka goyo milome mar lweny kod kethruok.
Omiyo wach Jehova Nyasaye osekelona ayany
“Ok analuonge kata wuoyo kendo e nyinge,”
Aol gi tingʼe e chunya; adier, ok anyal.
Osiepena duto rito mondo dhoga okier,
eka bangʼe wanapodh kuome kendo wanachul kuor kuome.”
To Jehova Nyasaye ni koda kaka jalweny maratego;
omiyo jogo masanda nochwanyre kendo ok giniloya.
Ok ginilo kendo ginibedi gi wichkuot malich;
wichkuot margi wich ok nowil godo.
kendo manyo matut mar chuny kod paro,
Werne Jehova Nyasaye! Pak Jehova Nyasaye!
Mad odiechiengʼ mane minwa onywola kik gwedhi!
Okwongʼ ngʼatno mane okelone wuonwa wach,
Mad ngʼatno chal gi mier mane
Jehova Nyasaye owito oko maonge ngʼwono.
kod ywak mar kedo e dier odiechiengʼ tir.
Nimar ne ok onega e ich,
ka ii minwa bedo kaka bur miika,
Angʼo momiyo ne awuok e ich
